correctness.rationale: Rotate to W±=(X±Y)/sqrt(2). The two ordered cross-mode covariances are (D−A)/2 and (D+A)/2, both with common reference value d_s/2. Their future-noise terms are orthogonal to the reference variables by conditional martingale mean zero, so they decay by the respective scalar transition gains exp(−K−U) and exp(−K+U). This proves the inverse, the need for nonzero d_s in these two channels only, and almost-everywhere derivative recovery. The instantaneous triangle is convex, so every admissible control average is realizable by that constant control; its exact exponential image is the stated region including semidefinite boundaries. Orthogonal sum/difference on input and output diagonalizes the derivative up to signs, leaving singular values |d_s| times the two gains. In the two-temperature specialization the diagonal difference obeys d′=−2kd+2(T_x−T_y); its stationary initialization and positive integrating factor give sign preservation.
residual_risks: The sensitivity is local, with d_s held fixed; the theorem does not analyze a noisy estimate of d_s, an arbitrary symmetric drift, or finite-data error.

evidence: Textbook Eqs. (6.64)–(6.65) give C(t,s)=Ψ(t,s)P(s) for arbitrary time-dependent linear Brownian drift. Orthogonality of the future stochastic integral carries the same identity over to the stated square-integrable martingale setting.

Baldassarri et al. invert equal-time Gaussian precision dynamics, a different inverse. Resultary 2026/11/22/...exact-rotational-blindness...--0ac3d73ad09e uses stationary covariances at two reset rates, not the same experiment.
broader_coverage.reasoning: It is the stronger linear-SDE covariance identity in the main Brownian setting, not the other control-inference paper or a reset experiment, that gives the central result. The martingale extension does not supply a nontrivial new mechanism.

evidence: The prior transition formula yields the two gains upon the fixed orthogonal rotation. In these same coordinates the control triangle is k±u≥0 and their sum ≤2k_max. Time averaging then exponentiating gives p,q≤1 and pq≥exp(−2k_max τ). Orthogonal transformations reduce the Jacobian to the two scalar exponential derivatives; zero common cross reference makes both channels zero.
Cerasoli et al.'s one-time effective-temperature statistics do not supply this implication.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The inverse, region, local conditioning, and channel degeneracy are immediate consequences of the same known regression and modal rates; a different packaging or a more general conditional-mean-zero driving noise does not establish the claimed scientific originality.

evidence: The two Cartesian contrasts are twice the two ordered cross-mode entries in the orthonormal gyrator basis, whose rates k±u are given by Patrón et al. The textbook gives the full lag regression in arbitrary coordinates; Ferreira et al. give the stationary version.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: In the known normal-mode representation, each of the claimed channels is just one scalar transition gain times the same equal-time cross entry. There is no additional matrix-identification step.

originality.rationale: The principal Brownian tomography and its stated refinements are directly implied by the published time-inhomogeneous linear-SDE lag covariance formula applied to the previously specified gyrator normal modes and control triangle. In those coordinates the selected observables are simply the two off-diagonal lagged covariances normalized by their common equal-time entry. The literature inspected did not print the full package in this notation and the textbook assumes Brownian noise. The martingale formulation replaces independent Brownian future noise by the conditional mean-zero orthogonality used in the same regression identity, without a distinct identification or control result beyond that identity.
residual_risks: No inspected source is claimed to publish the whole martingale formulation verbatim. The negative assessment is based on mathematical implication and an elementary noise-scope extension, not on search nonreturn or priority inferred from dates.

value.rationale: The two cross-mode statistics are convenient descriptors but here the reconstruction, attainable set and Jacobian reduce to the scalar linear-SDE regression, the exponential image of a convex triangle, and differentiation in orthogonal coordinates. No nonmechanical inverse, sharp statistical limitation, or control obstruction is established in the stated scope. This is a routine specialization of the available results, not a distinct exact invariant requiring new analysis.
residual_risks: This judgment concerns the stated population-level result; it does not discount possible practical utility or future statistical work.
